constraint_id_rule: Use the exact P1 JSON Pointer as stable constraint_id; lexical order; never renumber after candidate research.
inclusion_argument: Every retained predicate is an unconditional conjunction from P1. Properties/items are projected recursively, not copied with omitted assertions. Remove entire delegated applicators, never invert/hoist them. Therefore every exact-valid value satisfies all retained predicates. No semantic strengthening or extra constraints.

ownership_rules.ADAPTER_ENFORCED: Preserve six separate obligations; move none into decoder.
ownership_rules.DECODER_ENFORCED: Represent every dual-owned occurrence, exactly once, with source pointer and original predicate.
ownership_rules.EXACT_VALIDATOR_ENFORCED_only: No token-level approximation; explicitly delegate full original value/context, preserving all 46 occurrences.

phase_a_limit: No candidate capability research until freeze receipt event. No library syntax, regex or decoder-specific grammar.

representation_rules.items: Represent universal array-element scope; child predicates are separate decoder-owned entries. Do not copy delegated child predicates.
representation_rules.properties: Represent property-name to child-scope association, not an opaque copy of raw child schemas. Independently represent only decoder-owned children.
representation_rules.scope: Convert properties/name to JSON object field and items to every array element, using typed path steps; no conditional branch is hoisted.
representation_rules.unknown_owner_or_keyword: STOP; never omit an unrecognized mandatory rule.

semantic_domain: JSON values/object semantics; mathematical integers exclude boolean and include numerically integral JSON numbers.

serialization_policy.candidate_canonicalization: May be documented separately only if each valid semantic value retains at least one representation and no field/value combination is lost.
serialization_policy.rank_integer: Allow any legal textual representation of an integer semantic value in the abstract contract; canonical integer serialization is neutral if it preserves that value. Adapter lexical checks stay separate.
